dividendGrowth.title: Dividend growth per share
dividendGrowth.policy: Issuer dividends per share, independent of your holdings, purchases and tax. Years follow the issuer payment date in the reviewed timezone. Ordinary and special dividends are separate; YoY compares ordinary gross dividends for two complete calendar years in the same currency and common share unit. No FX conversion is applied. Unconfirmed payments, missing ordinary amounts, unknown classification or unconfirmed annual coverage suppress the percentage. Registered history is not automatically complete.
dividendGrowth.editorHelp: Amounts are gross per share. Explicitly review every calendar year and ALL share splits between the earliest unit basis and the common basis timestamp. Enter timestamps as RFC3339 with Z or an explicit offset (up to microseconds). Removing a row creates a new revision; previous evidence remains in the audit.
dividendGrowth.empty: No reviewed issuer dividend history. No growth rate can be inferred from personal cash receipts.
dividendGrowth.error: Unable to load or save dividend history.
dividendGrowth.invalid: Invalid history: check dates, source evidence, unique years, positive split ratios and amount precision (12 decimal places). The common basis must not be in the future.
dividendGrowth.instantError: Enter a valid timestamp with Z or an explicit offset, up to six fractional digits.
dividendGrowth.conflict: Data changed. Your input is retained. Close, refresh and reopen the current version before retrying.
dividendGrowth.splitReview: Confirmation of complete intervening split history
dividendGrowth.cancel: Cancel this history, preserve its revisions
dividendGrowth.yearHelp: Mark complete only after reviewing the entire calendar year, including confirmed zero dividends. An absent or incomplete year is unknown; a current year cannot produce completed-year YoY.
dividendGrowth.dividendHelp: Use gross amounts in this history currency. Issuer payment is confirmed by source evidence separately from dates or personal credits. Only confirmed issuer payments enter totals; an announced-only payment keeps the amount unknown. Empty amount is unknown. The unit basis timestamp identifies the source share unit independently of payment date, within the reviewed split range.
dividendGrowth.splitHelp: New units / old units is the share quantity multiplier. Older per-share dividends are multiplied by old / new for each later split through the common basis. A declaration with a unit basis exactly at the split uses the new unit. These rows do not alter your journal.
